title: helictotrichon pruinosum
intro: Helictotrichon pruinosum, commonly known as Silver Mist or White Wheat Grass, is a type of grass species in the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to support overall health. The health benefits of Helictotrichon pruinosum include its antioxidant properties, which help protect the body from oxidative stress and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
